title: dombeya multiflora var. senegalensis
intro: Dombeya multiflora var. senegalensis, commonly known as Senegal Flower, is a plant species that belongs to the Sterculiaceae family. It is native to Africa and has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including treating various health issues such as fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The health benefits of Senegal Flower include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of reducing pain and inflammation, as well as preventing the growth of microorganisms. The bioactive constituents of Senegal Flower include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
